outcome: Impulsive behaviour (measured using the Barratt Impulsivity Scale version-11c)
cohort: 57 children with ADHD from Madrid, Spain
finding: In children with ADHD, higher impulsivity scores were associated with shorter weekend sleep duration, poor adherence to the Mediterranean diet, excessive technology use, higher birth weight, cesarean delivery, and lack of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Children born via cesarean delivery had higher impulsivity scores.
